source: RFC 0007 §5.8; design B of the back-references, beta.5 (#1729)
statement: cosec-migrate repair-references converts a store written before 8.0.0-beta.5 and never replaces a back-reference set: it converts only a value CoCache reads in the old format, under a lease two runs share, adds and removes members otherwise, and removes the old document list last, only when nothing failed. A value no head touches stays in the old format and fails closed when a change touches it (CTL-42).
guards: migrate:LegacyConversionTest#a set is never replaced, so a member added after the conversion stays
migrate:MigrateMainTest#repair-references converts a store written before beta 5 and removes the old document list last
migrate:ReferenceRepairTest#a repair that fails part-way is reported, and the next run adds every missing member
